tickets.reservation: The wrong_if carries no single-day danger signal; on a name this far extended, a one-day fall of 1x atr_14d from the day's high (C7, my translation, not Livermore's number) belongs on the ticket's words.

tickets.objection: Trigger reclaim:ma_20 buys the pullback under the 20-day and its recovery, not a new high. C5 enters only on the new high after a normal reaction, never on the pullback itself.
tickets.would_clear: Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high (an hourly close above yesterday's high, the new high), as on ROKU and DIS.

tickets.objection: Trigger reclaim:ma_20 asks the name to fall under the 20-day and come back; that is buying the pullback, not the new high (C5). W HH/HL in an Upward Trend needs only the new high.
tickets.would_clear: Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high (an hourly close above yesterday's high, the new high).

tickets.objection: At from_52w_hi 0.0% the name is already making new highs; reclaim:ma_20 waits for a pullback under the 20-day and buys its recovery, which C5 forbids. A new high is the buy (C16).
tickets.would_clear: Trigger close_above:high_52w_close or h1_close_above:bar_high, the new high itself.

tickets.objection: Trigger reclaim:ma_20 buys a pullback under the 20-day and its recovery inside the range; C5 enters only on the new high out of it, never on the pullback itself.
tickets.would_clear: Trigger close_above:pivot_high, the new high out of the range.
